issue_request: FHIR-46201 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core profiling issue requesting that the MustSupport guidance recommend ElementDefinition.comment instead of ElementDefinition.definition because implementation expectations are usage guidance, not data-element meaning.
initial_application: The source change had already been applied by commit 04ead72d848aa2bde4ad3795704df79d8ae76730, which changed source/profiling.html from ElementDefinition.definition to ElementDefinition.comment in the Must Support / Implementation Obligations section.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml lists profiling.html in the Conformance build hierarchy. The cited Zulip thread confirms Lloyd McKenzie's agreement that MustSupport usage guidance belongs in .comment, and FHIR-I minutes for 2025-01-06 record the Persuasive 8-0-0 vote. FHIR-46200 and FHIR-28307 were background issues from the same thread about ElementDefinition self-note wording, not this profiling-page recommendation.
reconciliation: No source edit was made during reconciliation. The current source already has the requested ElementDefinition.comment wording, and a targeted search found no remaining ElementDefinition.definition recommendation in the relevant profiling/conformance obligations text.
